questions.question: Define the term 'net present value' (NPV) and explain why a positive NPV is desirable. (4 marks)

ThermoTech is deciding between two production machines. Machine A costs £200,000 with a payback period of 2 years. Machine B costs £350,000 with a payback of 3.5 years but generates significantly higher cash flows in years 4-8. Analyse the limitations of using payback period to evaluate this decision. (6 marks)

A hotel chain is deciding whether to build a new luxury resort (60% chance of high demand yielding £8m profit, 40% chance of low demand yielding £2m, costing £4m) or renovate existing hotels (certain return of £3m, costing £1.5m). Assess the value of decision tree analysis for this investment decision. (10 marks)

A logistics company must choose between investing £5 million in an automated warehouse system or £5 million in a fleet of electric delivery vehicles. Both have a 10-year expected life and the company's cost of capital is 8%. Evaluate which method of investment appraisal would be most useful for this decision. (20 marks)
Outline two benefits of using sensitivity analysis alongside investment appraisal. (4 marks)
